mechanism_narrative: An increase in the Consumer Price Index (CPI) above 2.5% YoY signals inflationary pressure, leading to tighter monetary policy expectations and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If CPIAUCSL YoY > 2.5% and S&P 500 forward 20-day returns are positive in more than 40% of the triggered instances.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp increase in the unemployment rate (UNRATE) by more than 0.5% in a month signals economic weakness, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: If UNRATE rises > 0.5% in 1 month and S&P 500 forward 5-day returns are positive in more than 60% of the triggered instances.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in housing starts (HOUST) over 3 months signals strengthening demand, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: If HOUST increases over 3 months and S&P 500 forward 60-day returns are negative in more than 40% of the periods.

mechanism_narrative: When the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) is above 2% and the GDP (GDPC1) growth rate is below 2% YoY, it signals a tightening monetary policy with weak economic growth, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
regime_hint: tightening monetary policy with weak growth
failure_condition: If FEDFUNDS > 2% and GDPC1 YoY < 2% and S&P 500 forward 20-day returns are positive in more than 50% of the triggered instances.

mechanism_narrative: A decrease in industrial production (INDPRO) by more than 1% in a month signals a supply shock, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If INDPRO falls > 1% in 1 month and S&P 500 forward 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of the triggered instances.

mechanism_narrative: An increase in nonfarm payrolls (PAYEMS) by more than 200,000 in a month signals strong labor market conditions, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: If PAYEMS increases > 200,000 in 1 month and S&P 500 forward 5-day returns are negative in more than 40% of the triggered instances.

mechanism_narrative: When real personal consumption expenditures (RSAFS) grow faster than GDP (GDPC1) over a quarter, it signals robust consumer demand, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
candidate_trigger: RSAFS growth > GDPC1 growth over 3 months
failure_condition: If RSAFS growth > GDPC1 growth over 3 months and S&P 500 forward 60-day returns are negative in more than 40% of the triggered instances.

mechanism_narrative: A decrease in the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) by more than 0.25% in a month signals accommodative monetary policy, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If FEDFUNDS falls > 0.25% in 1 month and S&P 500 forward 20-day returns are negative in more than 40% of the triggered instances.
